small_features.title: Generate playable video outcome from local backend
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can open a Video node editor, send prompt/duration plus connected image and audio inputs to the local backend, and receive one draggable playable Video outcome node on the canvas.
scope: Add shared request/response types for Video node generation.
Add FastAPI schemas, provider settings, provider wrapper, and route for local video generation.
Use Evolink Seedance reference-to-video when image URLs exist and text-to-video when prompt-only generation is requested.
Add frontend Video node API helper and floating editor.
Seed image_urls and audio_urls from connected image/audio outcome nodes when available.
Render a standalone Video outcome node with provider/model evidence, video controls, and one video output port.
Record no-persistence and future task-status limitations honestly.
